title: Covered in Mud, Facing the Sunrise

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"El Condor Pasa Accepts Challenge from
Rookie—Match to Be
Streamed Live!"
...Man, the media's all over it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But that aside, you've been having me
work on shortening my stride
nonstop. I
thought long strides were better for turf.
Are you sure
you've got this the right way
around?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A short stride takes a lot of small, quick steps, which is good for accelerating, but drains more stamina. Normally, it's recommended for dirt or sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For our match with El, we're not using
Tracen's track—I booked the
freestyle
course instead. The grass there isn't
maintained the way the
academy's turf is,
so it'll take a lot more strength to run on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm not preparing Nakayama
exclusively for Japanese-style
turf, I'm
teaching her skills that will help her run
reliably on any
surface, anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's yet another big claim outta you.
But I guess I'll go try out
the short strides
on the freestyle track itself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing like the school tracks
here—the turf or the dirt. Let's go
test
things out and plan from there. And then,
we raise a storm on the
big day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A "storm" indeed... There ends up being a
nasty, unexpected
downpour the night
before the race.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Last night's storm passed as quick as it
came, so we're lookin' at
bright, sunny
skies for our livestream of El Condor Pasa's
race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...That said, it turns out that her contestant really is a pre-debut rookie. So much for getting to see El Condor Pasa's full power.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, at least we get to film her at all.
Seeing her obliterate some
rookie will
show just how crazy fast she is, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah, they're dissing me without even
knowin' how I run. Sounds like
you've got
the whole crowd on your side, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm the condor that's flown
'round the world. People have
high
expectations for me, and you're about to
find out why the hard
way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, they're arguing like preschoolers.
Who knows if Nakayama's
overconfident or
just too green to know better, but it
doesn't matter
now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You'd better not make us watch something
as pathetic as last time.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And the two are off! The ground is a
mushy mess from the storm, but
that won't
stop the world's Phantom Bird, El Condor
Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(I see now. A world-class racer's
concentration and acceleration really
are
different. I don't have a shot in hell, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is losing speed! Is she
unable to keep up with El
Condor Pasa?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll set the pace then!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Whew, El Condor Pasa is crushing that
rookie. She's already got a
massive lead,
so she can slow down and save her energy,
no problem.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Guess all these Phantom Bird fans have
bird brains themselves.
They're not just
"slowing down"—take a look at the track
ahead of
them.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...Ack, that ain't good. El's swinging away
from the inner edge of the
track. She
must've caught on... The freestyle course
isn't like the
school's.)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! The inner edge of the third
and fourth turns is
completely
flooded—but the section ahead of El
Condor Pasa is clear!
The champ's got luck
on her side today!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's not "luck" if she's deliberately avoiding
the water. The puddles
are so deep, it'd
be like trying to run in a swamp. No one's
cutting
through that, which means...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(If I wanna pass El, I've gotta go all the
way around the outer edge.
It's that, or
the swamp. Either way, it'll be a big hit to
my stamina, so I
should take the safe
route...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But I'm not chickening out of a shortcut!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Hang on, that rookie's actually gaining ground in that swamp! It's a shortcut, yeah, but one slip and she could get hurt bad!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Damn right, it's risky as hell! But that's
what makes it exciting! This is
what it's all
about! This is a real race! A real contest!
This feeling—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This! THIS IS WHAT I LIVE FOOOR!

text_block_list.name: El & Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
HAAAAH!
AAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The world-class El Condor Pasa swooped
across the track for another
flawless
victory! No one deserves that world tour
more than her!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't this nice, El? The masses are
celebrating your big return to
racing. You
clutched out a second chance at the
global stage.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Wow, Sirius, way to rub it in. But you're right. Bein' out of practice is no excuse for almost gettin' upstaged by Nakayama. A pre-debut rookie! A newcomer. A literal amateur.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I get all smug over this win, she's
definitely outflyin' me next time.
But I
won't let that happen. The next match, the
whole world—it's all
mine!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, really? Are those the words of
someone who was just whining
about
finding a successor at her press
conference? Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama's gonna regret not finishing that
bird off when she had the
chance. You'd
better sharpen your claws if you want any
shot at the
Arc. The rest of the world's not
gonna sit around.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Man, El Condor Pasa really is the
champion! That other runner was
just
running her mouth after all. I mean, at
least the hype was fun, I
guess.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'd say that rookie's worth keeping
tabs on. Cinderella stories are
everywhere,
but some readers just wanna watch the boy
who cried
wolf crash and burn.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Haaah. I blew it big time. Haven't
even debuted yet, and my
career's already
shot.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Fair enough. Those reporters have
got me marked now. If I
bomb my next
race, the tabloids are gonna rip me to
shreds. Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's gotta be something wrong with me.
I feel like crap... but I feel
so alive! This
wasn't some kiddie sports match. My pulse
is screaming
for another hit of adrenaline!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what, you need a formal write-up to
call us a team? You and
me already
jumped off the deep end together.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So do it. Tell Tracen you're mine. And
then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Train me for more races that'll make me
feel alive.
